ev.q: themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia
You can build your own village, manage various industries
learn a wide variety of martial arts and secret techniques
marry your true love, raising children and fulfilling a destined romance
You can visit martial sects around the world
there are a *ton* of different builds
Negatives aside, this game is mind-blowingly fabulous, but unconventionally difficult.
each playthrough will be a brand-new adventure
you need to really try to understand the combat system to get through everything
